notes: Scientific review was incomplete for one or more calculations.
request: The chelate effect predicts that, at matched donor-atom equivalents, raising ligand denticity progressively lowers the free [Ni2+]. State this as a falsifiable monotonic prediction, then test it by computing Ni(II) speciation at pH 7 (1 mM Ni, 25 C, I=0.1 m) against monodentate ammonia at 60 mM, bidentate ethylenediamine at 30 mM and hexadentate EDTA at 10 mM (all about 60 mM in donor-atom equivalents), and report whether the free [Ni2+] falls monotonically from ammonia to en to EDTA or violates the denticity trend.
